next.reason: 1985 GR1: a declarative is invoked when its USE condition occurs; 'Only a declarative within the separately compiled program that contains the statement which caused the qualifying condition is invoked'; 'If no qualifying declarative exists ..., no declarative is executed' (1985 X.5.5.4 GR1 adds GLOBAL declaratives of containing programs). 2023 §2023:14.9.49.4 GR4 selects the declarative in the source element containing the causing statement, then GLOBAL ones in containing source elements up to 'the outermost source element'; §2023:14.9.49.4 GR3: 'If no declarative is identified, no declarative is executed'; §2023:14.9.49.4 GR6 a): 'the associated procedure is executed when the condition described in the USE statement occurs'. Propagation needs the PROPAGATE directive, absent from 1985 programs. Same.
